from.place: Since [n] is finite, its fibres have dimension zero, and the dimension formula for the surjective morphism A to H gives dim H = dim A - dim A[n] = dim A.

title: Finite surjective morphisms preserve dimension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ and $Y$ be nonempty schemes of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism. Then the topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of $X$ and $Y$ are finite and equal.
